title: Macaros: AROS as a native Apple Silicon app
description: Macaros runs AROS as a native Apple Silicon Mac app, with host integration, legacy 68k support, exFAT, Zed, Ferail and an automated test harness.

title: The plan was a faster file manager
description: How a slow tree view in Windows Explorer turned into Ferail: a Rust file manager built around speed, low cognitive cost and honest filenames - with the pun hiding in the name from day one.

title: Bringing exFAT to AROS
description: What it took to build portable, writable exFAT support for AROS, from clean-room specification to a disk that moves safely between operating systems.
